name: Lusti-Kartl'n
summary: Bavarian four-player partnership point-trick game where a trick is won by the last card matching the rank of the lead.
rules_text: Played with 32 Bavarian-pattern cards (Sixes removed) by two fixed teams of two sitting opposite. 8 cards each. No trumps, no requirement to follow suit or rank. To a trick each player plays one card in order. The winner is the last player to play a card whose rank equals the rank of the first card led; if no one matches, the leader wins. Aces and Tens are worth 10 each, plus 10 for the last trick, total 90. Team with 50+ points wins the deal. If a trick contains four cards of the same rank (Brand), it wins the whole game immediately for the player who played the last matching card, worth 4 game points. A match is usually 11 game points.
rating_reason: Team trick-taking with unusual rank-matching trick win rule
